scientific_integrity: The lower bound is proved by parity, quadratic-residue obstructions below 19, and complete divisor-count factorizations for 11 and 121. The upper bound is an explicit Dirichlet family. Finite code only replays residue computations and sample witnesses.
scientific_limitations: Determines the least nontrivial divisor-count value for tau(n) dividing n^2+n-1, not the least nontrivial integer n and not the complete set of attainable divisor counts.
title: The least nontrivial divisor count for \(\tau(n)\mid n^2+n-1\) is \(209\)
